title: Contrast enhanced Ultra-low-field-MRI in CNS infalmmation and brain tumors
summary:
Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) plays a very important role in the diagnosis and treatment of inflammation and tumors in the brain. However, conventional MRI scanners are large, expensive, and can only be operated in specially equipped rooms.

In our study, we aim to investigate whether newly developed, mobile ultra-low-field MRI devices (ULF-MRI) could serve as a useful supplement—or perhaps even an alternative—to conventional MRI systems.
conditions: Inflammatory disaeses of the brain, brain tumors

interventions.name: Native and contrast enhanced Ultra-low-filed-MRI of the brain, standard-MRI is performed independent from this study as part of standard clinical care

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
• Age over 18 years
• Capacity to give informed consent
• Suspected or confirmed cerebral mass lesion or inflammation of the brain
• Medical indication for performing a high-field MRI with contrast agent
Exclusion criteria:
• Contraindication to undergoing MRI (e.g., pacemaker)
• Severe claustrophobia that makes MRI examination impossible
• Pregnancy or breastfeeding
• Orthopedic conditions that do not allow prolonged lying down for the MRI examination
• Severe renal impairment
• Known hypersensitivity to gadolinium-based MRI contrast agents
